summary: Satya, co-host of the Melanin Millennials podcast, publicly announced their removal from the show and denial of co-creator rights by Shoutout Network (SON) following revelations that the network had acquired the show's trademark without consent. Satya detailed how they worked with CEO MML starting in 2015 under verbal agreements to create content for black British millennials, only to be abruptly replaced by new hosts and stripped of ownership despite contributing significantly to the show's growth and mission.
